_comment: Toy sightings map (sightings.html). endpoint = the Google Apps Script web app (scripts/sightings_apps_script.gs) in the Toy Ticker Map sheet: POST adds a report, GET returns recent ones as CSV. Leave it empty to keep reporting closed. Setup: README.md > Toy sightings map.
_window_help: window_days: reports older than this drop off the map. Toys rotate by case, so old reports mislead.
